introHtml: Benchmark reusable straws combine durability with a polished look, making them a reliable choice for businesses that want to reduce single-use plastic. These stainless steel straws are built to last through daily use in break rooms, cafeterias, or company events. With custom engraving or imprint options, your logo stays visible wash after wash. Whether you are equipping your own office or handing them out at trade shows, Benchmark straws offer a practical promotional item that recipients will actually keep using.
